name: mesh-ember
title: Ember Mesh Background
description: The Ember gradient mesh as a pure-CSS background. Four soft colour fields over a diagonal base — no image file and no network request.

files.content:
/** * envoyai — Ember Mesh Background * * The Ember gradient mesh as a pure-CSS background — no image file and no * network request. Four soft colour fields over a diagonal base, matching the * original 1200x800 artwork; positions and radii are percentages, so it scales * to any element at any aspect ratio. * * These are fixed-palette artwork, not theme-derived: the colours stay put in * light and dark. Pair with light text. * * Usage:
…
*/ .envoy-bg-mesh-ember { background-color: #000000; background-image: radial-gradient( ellipse 32% 48% at 12% 82%, rgb(18 8 6 / 0.95), rgb(18 8 6 / 0) 100% ), radial-gradient( ellipse 45.33% 68% at 62% 78%, rgb(122 31 0 / 0.95), rgb(122 31 0 / 0) 100% ), radial-gradient( ellipse 36% 54% at 78% 22%, rgb(255 61 61 / 0.95), rgb(255 61 61 / 0) 100% ), radial-gradient( ellipse 41.33% 62% at 22% 28%, rgb(255 122 24 / 0.95), rgb(255 122 24 / 0) 100% ), linear-gradient(135deg, #120806 0%, #000000 100%); }
